title: 8 Strategies for Handling Psychology Job Rejections

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 各位心理学家，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间以外的钱，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性的收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在 2022 年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的附属链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名截止日期为 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: Picture this.
sentences.zh: 想象一下这个场景。

sentences.en: You're scrolling through social media and you're met with a cascade of triumphant posts from people who've bagged job offers in the highly coveted roles that you want.
sentences.zh: 你正在浏览社交媒体，映入眼帘的是一连串胜利的帖子，发帖人都是那些拿到了你梦寐以求的、竞争激烈的职位的人。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, you're left with that sinking feeling that you just didn't quite get what you wanted.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，你却有一种沉重的感觉，觉得自己没能得到想要的东西。

sentences.en: But fear not, in today's episode, we are diving headfirst into the turbulent waters of job objections and disappointment in the field of psychology and mental health.
sentences.zh: 但别担心，在今天的节目中，我们将一头扎进心理学和心理健康领域中求职受挫和失望的汹涌波涛中。

sentences.en: Join me as we unpack the highs, the lows, and the learning points involved in each one of those rejection emails.
sentences.zh: 和我一起，我们将剖析每一封拒信背后的起起落落和学习要点。

sentences.en: So grab your favourite mug.
sentences.zh: 所以，拿上你最喜欢的杯子。

sentences.en: Mine is a herbal tea.
sentences.zh: 我喝的是花草茶。

sentences.en: And join me as together we dive in to this journey of resilience, determination and self-reflection.
sentences.zh: 加入我，让我们一起踏上这段关于韧性、决心和自我反思的旅程。

sentences.en: Hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得它很有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到“有抱负的心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: I know that this time of year can feel really tricky.
sentences.zh: 我知道每年的这个时候都会让人感觉非常棘手。

sentences.en: It can feel like everybody else is doing it.
sentences.zh: 感觉好像其他人都在做这件事。

sentences.en: So why can't I?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么我不行呢？

sentences.en: You might well notice the reference there from a Cranberries album.
sentences.zh: 你可能注意到了，这引用自小红莓乐队的一张专辑。

sentences.en: This time of year can feel really challenging.
sentences.zh: 每年的这个时候都会让人感觉非常有挑战性。

sentences.en: It can feel like everybody else is doing it.
sentences.zh: 感觉好像其他人都在做这件事。

sentences.en: So why can't I?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么我不行呢？

sentences.en: It can lead to self-reflection, self-criticism and also a dip in mood.
sentences.zh: 这可能会导致自我反思、自我批评，以及情绪低落。

sentences.en: Today I'm guiding you through eight consideration points that might help you to reposition yourself and help you bolster some enthusiasm to get through these next months.
sentences.zh: 今天，我将引导你思考八个要点，这些要点可能有助于你重新定位自己，并帮助你增强热情，以度过接下来的几个月。

sentences.en: Firstly, number one, I think it's really important that we normalise this experience.
sentences.zh: 首先，第一点，我认为将这种经历常态化非常重要。

sentences.en: It does feel a lot like rejection and sometimes when you get the emails through, it can feel like you've been kicked in the teeth or in the stomach or both.
sentences.zh: 这确实很像被拒绝，有时当你收到邮件时，感觉就像被人踢了牙齿或肚子，或者两者兼而有之。

sentences.en: That sense of disappointment, that sense of rejection is really common in psychology and really common in all career fields, actually.
sentences.zh: 那种失望感、那种被拒绝感在心理学领域非常普遍，实际上在所有职业领域都很普遍。

sentences.en: And I really want to normalise how often this happens.
sentences.zh: 我真的想让大家意识到这种情况发生的频率有多高。

sentences.en: When I got my first assistant psychologist post, for example, it was probably the 50th or 60th assistant psychologist job that I'd applied for, maybe more.
sentences.zh: 例如，当我获得第一份助理心理学家职位时，那可能是我申请的第 50 或 60 份助理心理学家工作，甚至更多。

sentences.en: I didn't keep a note.
sentences.zh: 我没有做记录。

sentences.en: It would have been helpful to do that, wouldn't it?
sentences.zh: 如果当时记下来会有帮助，不是吗？

sentences.en: And I know that it's even more competitive now.
sentences.zh: 而且我知道现在竞争更加激烈了。

sentences.en: And when I got on to clinical psychology doctoral training, that was the third time that I had applied.
sentences.zh: 当我进入临床心理学博士培训时，那是我第三次申请。

sentences.en: I know some of you may be listening to this and like, yeah, I'm happy to give it three goes, but this is time number five.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们中有些人听了可能会说，是的，我愿意尝试三次，但这已经是第五次了。

sentences.en: And I know it's really hard, but we also need to think about when we start applying as well.
sentences.zh: 我知道这真的很难，但我们也需要考虑我们开始申请的时间。

sentences.en: Because, of course, we know the minimum requirements are that you need to have, for example, for clinical psychology, you need to have your degree.
sentences.zh: 因为我们当然知道最低要求是，例如对于临床心理学，你需要拥有学位。

sentences.en: And they recommend that it's at least a year or two after you've got your degree qualification.
sentences.zh: 他们建议在获得学位资格后至少一两年。

sentences.en: And then you also need relevant experience.
sentences.zh: 而且你还需要相关的经验。

sentences.en: And so if you do start applying before you have that relevant experience, then that's going to be a no, not yet.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在拥有相关经验之前就开始申请，那么结果就是“不，还不行”。

sentences.en: But it might be that actually you weren't quite ready for that.
sentences.zh: 但可能实际上你还没准备好。

sentences.en: But even if you are feeling like you are ready, you might still feel like it's your time and you are ready.
sentences.zh: 即使你觉得你准备好了，你可能仍然觉得是时候了，你已经准备好了。

sentences.en: But you are not getting shortlisted and others are.
sentences.zh: 但你没有进入面试名单，而别人却进了。

sentences.en: And that is really hard.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难受。

sentences.en: I know from my work in supporting aspiring psychologists through the podcast, through the compassionate Q&As, and through my aspiring psychologist membership, that actually,
sentences.zh: 我从通过播客、富有同情心的问答环节以及我的“有抱负的心理学家”会员计划支持有抱负的心理学家的工作中了解到，实际上，

sentences.en: you know, the thing that most is predictive of success is perseverance.
sentences.zh: 你知道，最能预示成功的事情是毅力。

sentences.en: And I know it's hard.
sentences.zh: 我知道这很难。

sentences.en: I know it's hard to keep going.
sentences.zh: 我知道坚持下去很难。

sentences.en: And I know it can feel like self-flagellation, self-punishment and kind of masochistic that we don't know whether there will ever be the prize that you seek.
sentences.zh: 而且我知道这可能会让人感觉像是一种自我鞭笞、自我惩罚，甚至是一种受虐倾向，因为我们不知道你追求的奖赏是否终会到来。

sentences.en: But like I said, the one thing we know that makes it more likely is by continuing.
sentences.zh: 但正如我所说，我们知道唯一能增加成功可能性的事情就是继续前进。

sentences.en: It hurts.
sentences.zh: 这很痛。

sentences.en: I know that.
sentences.zh: 我知道这一点。

sentences.en: And it's OK to lean into that.
sentences.zh: 接受这种痛苦是可以的。

sentences.en: It's OK to be sad.
sentences.zh: 感到难过是可以的。

sentences.en: Talk to people who are on your team.
sentences.zh: 和你的团队成员谈谈。

sentences.en: Talk to people who, and when I say on your team, I don't necessarily mean in your job role.
sentences.zh: 和那些人谈谈，当我提到“你的团队”时，我不一定是指你的工作岗位上的同事。

sentences.en: I mean people that get you, people that aren't going to minimise you, people that aren't going to squash down.
sentences.zh: 我是指那些懂你的人，那些不会贬低你的人，那些不会打压你的人。

sentences.en: You know, so when people are grieving and somebody might say, oh, well, they were quite old or, you know, they had a good innings or, you know, you know, they've had a good life.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当人们在哀悼时，有人可能会说，哦，好吧，他们年纪很大了，或者，你知道，他们已经活够本了，或者，你知道，他们度过了美好的一生。

sentences.en: That's not that helpful.
sentences.zh: 那并没有什么帮助。

sentences.en: And those might not be the kinds of people that you want to seek support from at that time.
sentences.zh: 那些可能不是你在那个时候想要寻求支持的人。

sentences.en: We want you to be surrounded by people who get it, who are able to sit with your sadness and don't feel that need to fix it.
sentences.zh: 我们希望你被那些懂你的人包围，他们能够陪伴你的悲伤，而不觉得有必要去“修复”它。

sentences.en: So make sure you've got some people in your life who can do that.
sentences.zh: 所以确保你生活中有一些能做到这一点的人。

sentences.en: So that's our first point, normalising rejection.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们的第一点，将拒绝常态化。

sentences.en: I've sort of strayed into the territory for point number two, which is resilience and persistence.
sentences.zh: 我刚才已经谈到了第二点，即韧性和坚持。

sentences.en: Now, this can feel dogged.
sentences.zh: 现在，这可能会让人感到顽固。

sentences.en: It can feel like really hard work.
sentences.zh: 这可能会让人感觉是非常艰苦的工作。

sentences.en: What I noticed when I was putting together the Clinical Psychologist Collective and the Aspiring Psychologist Collective is that time and time again,
sentences.zh: 当我在筹备“临床心理学家集体”和“有抱负的心理学家集体”时，我注意到一次又一次，

sentences.en: people were talking about their resilience.
sentences.zh: 人们在谈论他们的韧性。

sentences.en: They were talking about their persistence.
sentences.zh: 他们在谈论他们的坚持。

sentences.en: They were talking about the reflection points that they got from setbacks, from being told no.
sentences.zh: 他们在谈论他们从挫折、从被拒绝中获得的思考点。

sentences.en: Even my own experience of, you know, being told at undergraduate level that clinical psychology was really, really hard to get into and, you know, you probably shouldn't bother.
sentences.zh: 甚至我自己的经历，你知道，在本科阶段被告知临床心理学非常非常难进入，而且，你知道，你可能不应该费心了。

sentences.en: Go do something else.
sentences.zh: 去干点别的吧。

sentences.en: I was like, right, right.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，好吧，好吧。

sentences.en: I like a challenge.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢挑战。

sentences.en: I'm resilient.
sentences.zh: 我有韧性。

sentences.en: I can do this.
sentences.zh: 我能做到。

sentences.en: Which, again, is not necessarily the healthiest perspective.
sentences.zh: 这再次说明，这不一定是最健康的观点。

sentences.en: But if that's what you're experiencing, again, that is normalising that many of us do do that.
sentences.zh: 但如果你正在经历这些，再次说明，这常态化了我们许多人确实会那样做的事实。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm trying to tell you to do it, but don't do it my way.
sentences.zh: 是的，我试图告诉你去做，但不要用我的方式。

sentences.en: But I know that you are still human and you're going to be having the same thoughts,
sentences.zh: 但我知道你仍然是人，你会有同样的想法、

sentences.en: feelings and thought processes that I did because you want it likely as much as I did and as much as I do.
sentences.zh: 感受和思维过程，因为你想要的可能和我当时一样多，也和我现在一样多。

sentences.en: You know, psychology and this field of psychology and clinical psychology for me is something I'm saying yes to every day still, even now, even though I qualified in 2011.
sentences.zh: 你知道，心理学以及这个心理学和临床心理学的领域对我来说，是我每天仍然在说“是”的事情，即使是现在，尽管我在 2011 年就获得了资格。

sentences.en: And I think that's really my top tip for this resilience and persistence is are you still saying yes to that?
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实是我关于韧性和坚持的最高建议：你还在对它说“是”吗？

sentences.en: If you are still saying yes to that, that's OK.
sentences.zh: 如果你还在对它说“是”，那没关系。

sentences.en: You're choosing that.
sentences.zh: 你在选择它。

sentences.en: It's like that old analogy of marriage.
sentences.zh: 这就像婚姻的那个古老的类比。

sentences.en: You know, you're choosing to keep saying yes to that person that you've married every day.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你每天都在选择继续对你结婚的那个人说“是”。

sentences.en: And we need to be looking to make sure that that is still a relationship that you want to be in with your pursuit of psychology.
sentences.zh: 我们需要确保这仍然是你想要与你的心理学追求保持的关系。

sentences.en: If it is, then you can keep going.
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，那么你可以继续前进。

sentences.en: But do make sure that you've got those people around you who help make the journey that little bit more compassionate.
sentences.zh: 但一定要确保你身边有那些能让这段旅程变得更富有同情心的人。

sentences.en: Point number three is self-reflection.
sentences.zh: 第三点是自我反思。

sentences.en: Take a moment to look back at your job application.
sentences.zh: 花点时间回顾一下你的求职申请。

sentences.en: And if that is a doctoral process, then look back at the form that you applied.
sentences.zh: 如果那是博士申请过程，那么回顾一下你申请时填写的表格。

sentences.en: Look at it with fresh eyes, if you can.
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，用全新的眼光去看它。

sentences.en: So try to be extracted from the process where you're thinking about that as yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以试着从那个过程中抽离出来，以旁观者的角度思考你自己。

sentences.en: Of course, by the time that you are coming back to reflect on this, it is likely to have been some months since you applied.
sentences.zh: 当然，当你回过头来反思这一点时，距离你申请可能已经过去几个月了。

sentences.en: So what we would expect is that you would have had new insights, new thoughts, new reflections, new learning objectives, new ways of thinking about things.
sentences.zh: 所以我们期望的是，你会有新的见解、新的想法、新的反思、新的学习目标、新的思考事物的方式。

sentences.en: You know, subsequent supervision sessions or learning experiences with clients that have led you to think about things differently.
sentences.zh: 你知道，随后的督导会议或与客户的学习经历让你以不同的方式思考问题。

sentences.en: As you look at your form, look at what you would do differently.
sentences.zh: 当你查看你的表格时，看看你会做些什么不同的事情。

sentences.en: Is everything you've written powerful, punchy?
sentences.zh: 你写的一切都有力、简洁吗？

sentences.en: Have you written too much about something?
sentences.zh: 你是不是在某件事上写得太多了？

sentences.en: Have you not left enough room to talk about other things?
sentences.zh: 你是不是没有留出足够的空间来谈论其他事情？

sentences.en: Sometimes we can be a little bit more succinct, which means we can get more bang for our buck in our application forMs.
sentences.zh: 有时我们可以更简洁一点，这意味着我们在申请表格中可以获得更大的回报。

sentences.en: As part of this reflection section, it might be that you can invite feedback from other people as well.
sentences.zh: 作为反思部分的一部分，你也可以邀请其他人提供反馈。

sentences.en: Perhaps somebody else that has either been successful or hasn't been successful.
sentences.zh: 也许是其他成功或不成功的人。

sentences.en: Maybe even your supervisor or manager or other people in your team who have a valid and useful viewpoint.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能是你的导师、经理或团队中其他有有效且有用观点的人。

sentences.en: It can be useful as well to get people who are non-experts to look at your form as well, to make sure that it makes sense from a common sense perspective,
sentences.zh: 让非专家的人看看你的表格也很有用，以确保它从常识的角度来看是有意义的，

sentences.en: but also that it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 而且它也很有趣。

sentences.en: We can forget that it's supposed to be an interesting thing to read.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会忘记它应该是一件有趣的事情。

sentences.en: It isn't just all supposed to be, I don't know, formulaic and doom and gloom and boring.
sentences.zh: 它不应该全是，我不知道，公式化、阴郁和无聊的内容。

sentences.en: It's supposed to be interesting.
sentences.zh: 它应该是有趣的。

sentences.en: It's supposed to be engaging.
sentences.zh: 它应该是引人入胜的。

sentences.en: And you might well find it helpful to listen back to the episode I did with Nikita, where she talks about some of the lively ways that she perked up her form.
sentences.zh: 你可能会发现听听我和 Nikita 的那一期节目很有帮助，她在节目中谈到了她让表格变得生动的一些方法。

sentences.en: And that episode was called How to Get On to Clinical Training in Record Time or something like that.
sentences.zh: 那期节目的标题是“如何以创纪录的时间进入临床培训”之类的。

sentences.en: We mustn't forget, of course, that we do learn things from experiences that don't go our way.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们不能忘记，我们确实从不顺利的经历中学到了东西。

sentences.en: It feels like a little bit of an excrement sandwich that you feel like you're having to learn stuff from the stuff that goes well to make it more palatable.
sentences.zh: 这感觉有点像“排泄物三明治”，你觉得你必须从那些顺利的事情中学习东西，才能让它变得更容易接受。

sentences.en: I really do think we can learn from the things that we don't get.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为我们可以从我们没有得到的东西中学到东西。

sentences.en: It makes me think of, you know, when you're looking for something and you're like, you might say, oh, it was in the last place I looked.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起，你知道，当你寻找某样东西时，你可能会说，哦，它在最后我找的地方。

sentences.en: Well, of course it was in the last place you looked because then you stopped looking because you'd found it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，当然它在最后你找的地方，因为那时你停止了寻找，因为你找到了它。

sentences.en: But it's what do we find?
sentences.zh: 但我们发现了什么？

sentences.en: What do we discover along the way?
sentences.zh: 我们在路上发现了什么？

sentences.en: Might well help us put strategies in place so that we don't lose our keys, for example, so that we can make our next experience of applying more frictionless.
sentences.zh: 这可能有助于我们制定策略，这样我们就不会弄丢钥匙，例如，这样我们可以让下一次申请的经历更顺畅。

sentences.en: Because we're not wasting time.
sentences.zh: 因为我们没有浪费时间。

sentences.en: We're being more purposeful.
sentences.zh: 我们更有目标感。

sentences.en: We're being more focused.
sentences.zh: 我们更专注。

sentences.en: We are having less chance for setbacks.
sentences.zh: 我们减少了挫折的机会。

sentences.en: It's that process of errorless learning that you might well have learned about in your undergraduate or your A-level studies.
sentences.zh: 这就是你可能在本科或 A-level 学习中了解到的“无错学习”过程。

sentences.en: That's what we're looking to do here.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在这里要做的。

sentences.en: We're looking to make this job application, job interview experience as friction free as possible so that the next time we've got a better chance of success.
sentences.zh: 我们正在寻求让这次求职、面试经历尽可能顺畅，以便下一次我们有更好的成功机会。

sentences.en: Point number four is exploring alternatives.
sentences.zh: 第四点是探索替代方案。

sentences.en: Now, I know I said that resilience and determination was important, but you also matter.
sentences.zh: 现在，我知道我说过韧性和决心很重要，但你也同样重要。

sentences.en: And it might be that you decide to down tools for a bit, that you decide to go and do something different.
sentences.zh: 你可能会决定暂时放下工具，决定去做点别的事情。

sentences.en: You decide to go traveling or to explore something different and then come back to psychology at a later stage.
sentences.zh: 你决定去旅行或探索一些不同的东西，然后在以后的阶段回到心理学。

sentences.en: Or it might just be that you decide, actually, clearly this job role that I've got at the moment isn't helping me develop or grow in the way that I need to.
sentences.zh: 或者可能只是你决定，实际上，显然我现在拥有的这个职位并没有帮助我以我需要的方式发展或成长。

sentences.en: Or maybe I have developed and grown as much as I can from this job role.
sentences.zh: 或者也许我已经从这份工作中获得了尽可能多的发展和成长。

sentences.en: And it's time to think about broadening to a different clinical area or to a more clinically relevant area or experience.
sentences.zh: 是时候考虑扩展到不同的临床领域或更具临床相关性的领域或经验了。

sentences.en: Maybe you can move to a job where you're supervised by a qualified psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 也许你可以换一份由合格心理学家督导的工作。

sentences.en: Maybe you can move to a job where it's a training role.
sentences.zh: 也许你可以换一份培训职位的工作。

sentences.en: And whilst that might mean that you are tied in for a little bit for a few years, because perhaps you've accessed higher education England funding,
sentences.zh: 虽然这可能意味着你会被束缚几年，因为也许你获得了英格兰高等教育的资助，

sentences.en: it might still be worth it in the long run because of what you learn and how you're able to use those skills to make sure that ultimately you are successful.
sentences.zh: 但从长远来看，这仍然是值得的，因为你学到的东西以及你如何能够利用这些技能来确保你最终获得成功。

sentences.en: Maybe you could look at maybe making your role part time so that you've got capacity to be able to engage in a different part time, hopefully paid role.
sentences.zh: 也许你可以考虑让你的工作变成兼职，这样你就有能力从事另一份兼职的、希望是有薪的工作。

sentences.en: Money is important.
sentences.zh: 钱很重要。

sentences.en: It does make your life that bit easier to manage.
sentences.zh: 它确实让你的生活变得更容易管理。

sentences.en: But maybe there's potential for you to drop down, to be able to give you more capacity for learning about different clinical areas,
sentences.zh: 但也许你有潜力去尝试降级，从而腾出更多精力去学习不同的临床领域，

sentences.en: different clinical populations within your same 37 and a half hours a week.
sentences.zh: 在每周同样的37.5小时工作时间内，接触不同的临床人群。

sentences.en: Now, I will level with you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我要跟你说句掏心窝子的话。

sentences.en: Having done split posts, it does feel like you are doing more than a whole time equivalent role.
sentences.zh: 做过分职岗位的人都知道，这感觉就像是在做一份超过全职工作量的工作。

sentences.en: So you need to go into that with your eyes open as well.
sentences.zh: 所以你在选择时也需要睁大眼睛，看清楚这一点。

sentences.en: But you do learn so much in the early months of a new role.
sentences.zh: 但你在新职位的最初几个月里确实能学到很多东西。

sentences.en: And I remember when I was in training that you have such a rapid expansion of knowledge, skills and expertise in those early days, weeks and months.
sentences.zh: 我记得我在受训时，在那些最初的日子、几周和几个月里，知识、技能和专业能力都有着飞速的增长。

sentences.en: You know, you still you feel like maybe you plateau by the time you're reaching the end of the placement.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可能会觉得在实习快结束时，自己的进步进入了平台期。

sentences.en: You feel like you're probably getting into your stride by the end of the six months.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得到六个月结束时，你可能才刚刚进入状态。

sentences.en: Really, probably as much as you're going to learn about that clinical population has come in those first few months, I would say.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我想你对那个临床人群大部分的了解，可能都是在那最初的几个月里获得的。

sentences.en: And in those formative conversations that you will have with your clinical supervisor, with your manager, with the people around you.
sentences.zh: 还有你与临床督导、经理以及周围同事进行的那些具有启发性的对话。

sentences.en: So could you broaden your experience to include another job role?
sentences.zh: 那么，你能不能拓宽你的经验，去尝试另一种工作岗位呢？

sentences.en: Hopefully, like I said, a paid job role.
sentences.zh: 希望正如我所说，是一份有薪水的工作。

sentences.en: If you are considering honorary work, please do check out my recent video on why honorary roles are problematic.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在考虑无薪实习，请务必看看我最近关于为什么无薪职位存在问题的视频。

sentences.en: When we are considering broadening our repertoire, our job search, then the Inspiring Psychologists Collective book can be really, really useful in that.
sentences.zh: 当我们考虑拓宽我们的技能储备和求职范围时，《有抱负的心理学家集体》（Inspiring Psychologists Collective）这本书真的非常非常有帮助。

sentences.en: Because in that, people discuss the job roles they've applied for, people discuss the job roles they've had.
sentences.zh: 因为在书中，人们讨论了他们申请过的工作岗位，也讨论了他们曾经担任过的职位。

sentences.en: And, you know, if we don't know what the job titles are, it can be really difficult to search for them.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，如果我们不知道职位名称是什么，搜索起来会非常困难。

sentences.en: So you might well find that to be a useful read.
sentences.zh: 所以你很可能会发现这是一本很有用的读物。

sentences.en: Now, let's have a quick break and I will be back along very soon.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们休息一下，我很快就会回来。

sentences.en: Welcome back along.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: Do these jingles get stuck in your head in the way that they do mine?
sentences.zh: 这些广告短曲是不是像在我脑子里一样，也一直挥之不去？

sentences.en: How are you finding this podcast?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这个播客怎么样？

sentences.en: I would love your feedback.
sentences.zh: 我很希望能得到你的反馈。

sentences.en: I would love to have your voice on the podcast telling me about your experiences with the podcast or with the membership or even with the free compassionate Q&As
sentences.zh: 我很希望能听到你的声音出现在播客里，告诉我你对播客、会员服务，甚至是免费的同理心问答环节的体验，

sentences.en: or with the Clinical Psychologist Collective book or the Aspiring Psychologist Collective book.
sentences.zh: 或者对《临床心理学家集体》或《有抱负的心理学家集体》这两本书的看法。

sentences.en: Please do get in contact with me.
sentences.zh: 请务必与我联系。

sentences.en: You can go to my website www.goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk forward slash podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 你可以访问我的网站 www.goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk/podcast。

sentences.en: And you can learn there how to leave me an audio testimonial or just drop me a voice note on Instagram or LinkedIn and we can go from there.
sentences.zh: 你可以在那里了解如何给我留下音频感言，或者直接在 Instagram 或 LinkedIn 上给我发语音留言，我们之后再详谈。

sentences.en: And please also do take a moment to rate the podcast if you're listening on Spotify.
sentences.zh: 如果你是在 Spotify 上收听，也请花点时间给播客评分。

sentences.en: And if you're listening on Apple Podcasts, please do rate and review the podcast as it helps us to reach a wider audience.
sentences.zh: 如果你是在 Apple Podcasts 上收听，请务必给播客评分和评论，因为这有助于我们触达更广泛的受众。

sentences.en: And one of the most beneficial things you can do for me for free, which takes you less than a nanosecond,
sentences.zh: 而且，你可以免费为我做的最有益的事情之一，只需不到一纳秒的时间，

sentences.en: is to click subscribe or follow on the platform that you are watching or listening to this on.
sentences.zh: 就是点击你正在观看或收听的平台上的订阅或关注按钮。

sentences.en: So in the first half of this episode, we were looking at my top four ways for navigating your way through that sense of, oh no, everyone else is getting the job offers that I want.
sentences.zh: 在这一集的上半部分，我们探讨了我提出的四种方法，来应对那种“噢不，其他人都在拿到我想要的工作机会”的感觉。

sentences.en: And I'm going to be bringing you four more reflection and thought points around this hot, painful, ouchy topic.
sentences.zh: 我将带给你另外四个关于这个热门、痛苦且令人难受的话题的思考点。

sentences.en: Number five.
sentences.zh: 第五点。

sentences.en: And it is looking after your well-being.
sentences.zh: 那就是照顾好你的身心健康。

sentences.en: I know this is really hard.
sentences.zh: 我知道这真的很难。

sentences.en: I know that it feels like your whole life is on hold.
sentences.zh: 我知道这感觉就像你整个人生都处于停滞状态。

sentences.en: And I know that this is something that you really, really want.
sentences.zh: 我也知道这是你非常、非常想要的东西。

sentences.en: But the importance of talking about that with people who get it, but also people who just love and adore you is so important.
sentences.zh: 但与那些懂你的人，以及那些真正爱你、崇拜你的人谈论这些，是非常重要的。

sentences.en: Do other things as well as psychology.
sentences.zh: 除了心理学，也要做点别的事情。

sentences.en: Have other hobbies.
sentences.zh: 培养其他的爱好。

sentences.en: Know that it's okay to pursue those.
sentences.zh: 要知道去追求这些爱好是没问题的。

sentences.en: So I only really got into exercise probably about four years ago, but I really wish I got it sooner because actually I really enjoy running and weight training.
sentences.zh: 我大概是四年前才真正开始运动的，但我真希望自己能早点开始，因为实际上我真的很喜欢跑步和力量训练。

sentences.en: And it really helps me manage everything that I've got going on.
sentences.zh: 这真的能帮我管理好我生活中正在发生的一切。

sentences.en: You might not be into running, might not be into weight training, but hopefully there's some other form of exercise.
sentences.zh: 你可能不喜欢跑步，也不喜欢力量训练，但希望还有其他形式的运动适合你。

sentences.en: Maybe something that helps you do mindfulness as well, like yoga or Pilates.
sentences.zh: 也许是一些能帮你进行正念练习的运动，比如瑜伽或普拉提。

sentences.en: Something that gets your heart racing, but can give you space to do something different, something where you are immersed in that moment.
sentences.zh: 做一些能让心跳加速的事情，但同时能给你空间去做点不同的事，让你沉浸在当下的时刻。

sentences.en: And when you're lifting a really heavy weight, you can't really think about anything else.
sentences.zh: 当你举起非常重的重量时，你真的无法思考其他任何事情。

sentences.en: So that is the beauty of it giving you a transformation, of giving you a break.
sentences.zh: 这就是它的魅力所在，它能带给你转变，让你得到喘息。

sentences.en: And actually, sometimes when I'm in a really bad mood and I go and see my personal trainer,
sentences.zh: 事实上，有时当我心情非常糟糕时，我会去见我的私人教练，

sentences.en: I just feel different afterwards because I've used my body and I've used my mind in a very different way.
sentences.zh: 之后我感觉就不一样了，因为我以一种非常不同的方式运用了我的身体和大脑。

sentences.en: And it just alters my whole being, my whole, you know, the way I kind of spring out of there after that is, it is transformative.
sentences.zh: 这改变了我的整个状态，那种在训练后充满活力的感觉，真的是一种蜕变。

sentences.en: And so please do consider whether exercise, you know, and this is ability inclusive as well.
sentences.zh: 所以请务必考虑一下运动，而且这对于不同能力水平的人都是包容的。

sentences.en: You know, whatever your level of ability is, there is something you can do that stretches your body, that stretches your mind,
sentences.zh: 无论你的能力水平如何，总有一些事情是你能够做的，能拉伸你的身体，拉伸你的思维，

sentences.en: that gives you a best chance of using it as a well-being activity.
sentences.zh: 让你有最好的机会将其作为一种身心健康活动。

sentences.en: Please do know that I get it.
sentences.zh: 请一定要知道，我理解你的感受。

sentences.en: You know, this is really hard.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这真的很难。

sentences.en: One of the really great things about the Aspiring Psychologist membership is that other people are around who get it just like you do and who aren't going to try and cheer you up,
sentences.zh: “有抱负的心理学家”会员服务的一大优点是，周围有和你一样懂你的人，他们不会试图强行让你振作起来，

sentences.en: who just are able to sit with you.
sentences.zh: 而是能够静静地陪伴着你。

sentences.en: So please do consider whether the Aspiring Psychologist membership might also be a really great way of looking after your well-being,
sentences.zh: 所以请务必考虑一下，“有抱负的心理学家”会员服务是否也是一种照顾你身心健康的好方法，

sentences.en: but also of helping you maximise your chances of success in the future.
sentences.zh: 同时也能帮助你最大化未来成功的机会。

sentences.en: Point number six is networking and professional development.
sentences.zh: 第六点是社交和职业发展。

sentences.en: Now, of course, networking is something that I do really well on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 当然，社交是我在 LinkedIn 上做得非常好的事情。

sentences.en: So do come over and connect with me on there.
sentences.zh: 所以一定要过来和我建立联系。

sentences.en: Get involved in my comments.
sentences.zh: 参与我的评论区互动。

sentences.en: Get involved in sharing the posts and liking them, having conversations with people in the comments as well.
sentences.zh: 参与分享帖子、点赞，并在评论区与他人交流。

sentences.en: That's where the gold happens.
sentences.zh: 那才是金子般珍贵的地方。

sentences.en: You know, that's where many of the guests for the podcast come from is from interesting conversations on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 你知道，播客的许多嘉宾都是来自 LinkedIn 上有趣的对话。

sentences.en: And when we follow people who inspire us, it can lead us to have different ways of thinking about tackling our probleMs.
sentences.zh: 当我们关注那些激励我们的人时，这会引导我们用不同的方式去思考如何解决问题。

sentences.en: I love LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 我爱 LinkedIn。

sentences.en: I know I talk about LinkedIn all the time, but I really do see it as a brilliant professional networking site.
sentences.zh: 我知道我一直在谈论 LinkedIn，但我真的认为它是一个出色的专业社交网站。

sentences.en: But, you know, regardless of what stage of your career you are at, get on LinkedIn because it will, I honestly believe it will help you get there quicker.
sentences.zh: 但是，无论你处于职业生涯的哪个阶段，都要加入 LinkedIn，因为我真心相信它会帮你更快地达到目标。

sentences.en: But LinkedIn isn't the only way to network and to kind of think about broadening your business relationships.
sentences.zh: 但 LinkedIn 并不是社交和拓宽商业关系的唯一途径。

sentences.en: You can go to conferences.
sentences.zh: 你可以参加会议。

sentences.en: You can go to training events.
sentences.zh: 你可以参加培训活动。

sentences.en: They might well be something that's funded for you by your employer, but you may still have to search for that yourself.
sentences.zh: 这些活动可能由你的雇主为你资助，但你可能仍然需要自己去寻找这些机会。

sentences.en: Sometimes these opportunities don't just end up in your email inbox.
sentences.zh: 有时这些机会并不会自动出现在你的收件箱里。

sentences.en: You know, you could consider joining the British Psychological Society if that's something you felt like you wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你有这个意愿，可以考虑加入英国心理学会（British Psychological Society）。

sentences.en: And they will send you any relevant networking or training events.
sentences.zh: 他们会给你发送任何相关的社交或培训活动信息。

sentences.en: They are not free.
sentences.zh: 这些不是免费的。

sentences.en: I am part of the Association for Clinical Psychology as well, the ACP, and their events.
sentences.zh: 我也是临床心理学协会（ACP）的成员，他们的活动，

sentences.en: Once I am a member, they are free.
sentences.zh: 一旦成为会员，就是免费的。

sentences.en: But I don't actually think you can register as an undergrad.
sentences.zh: 但我其实认为你本科生是无法注册的。

sentences.en: Let me just check that out for you.
sentences.zh: 让我为你查一下。

sentences.en: So I've just had a little look and the ACP is only available to trainee psychologists or qualified clinical psychologists,
sentences.zh: 我刚才查了一下，ACP 只对受训心理学家或合格的临床心理学家开放，

sentences.en: or those that want to be affiliated but aren't eligible for full registration.
sentences.zh: 或者那些想要加入但没有资格进行全面注册的人。

sentences.en: But you might well find it useful to go to local research meetings or kind of trust events that are happening,
sentences.zh: 但你可能会发现参加当地的研究会议或正在进行的信托活动很有用，

sentences.en: local aspiring psychologist meetings in your trust to maybe set your own up.
sentences.zh: 或者在你的信托机构内参加当地的“有抱负的心理学家”会议，甚至自己组织一个。

sentences.en: Invite interesting people to come and talk to you.
sentences.zh: 邀请有趣的人来和你交流。

sentences.en: And that's something that I've done for assistant psychologist groups as well.
sentences.zh: 这也是我为助理心理学家小组做过的事情。

sentences.en: You know, you can create what you want to see or you can come on board to what's already available.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可以创造你想看到的东西，或者加入现有的组织。

sentences.en: Having conversations is a key part of being a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 进行对话是成为一名心理学家的关键部分。

sentences.en: And so don't be afraid to do it.
sentences.zh: 所以不要害怕去做。

sentences.en: You know, do connect with people on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 你知道，一定要在 LinkedIn 上与人建立联系。

sentences.en: Do follow people.
sentences.zh: 一定要关注他人。

sentences.en: You know, do the same on Instagram.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在 Instagram 上也要这样做。

sentences.en: Just, you know, engage.
sentences.zh: 只是，你知道，参与其中。

sentences.en: Be interested and learn.
sentences.zh: 保持兴趣并不断学习。

sentences.en: Point number seven is that we are setting realistic expectations.
sentences.zh: 第七点是我们要设定现实的期望。

sentences.en: We are pacing ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们要调整自己的节奏。

sentences.en: We are knowing that actually maybe applying for a doctorate when you're one month out of finishing your degree or perhaps when you are in the middle of a two or three year master's study program might not be that realistic.
sentences.zh: 我们要知道，实际上，在大学毕业一个月后就申请博士学位，或者在两到三年的硕士学习期间申请，可能并不那么现实。

sentences.en: It's not always impossible.
sentences.zh: 这并非完全不可能。

sentences.en: It isn't always impossible.
sentences.zh: 这并不是不可能的。

sentences.en: But pacing yourself and making sure that really this is your time and you're ready for this next step can be really, really important.
sentences.zh: 但调整好节奏，确保这确实是属于你的时机，并且你已经为下一步做好了准备，这真的非常非常重要。

sentences.en: And, you know, I have had very recent experiences with people who maybe applied to courses all over the UK and maybe were offered one furthest from their home.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我最近有接触过一些人，他们可能申请了英国各地的课程，但最后只收到了离家最远的录取通知。

sentences.en: And maybe they wish that they declined it because actually the realities of living so far away from your support systems and everything you know isn't always as rosy as you might have expected.
sentences.zh: 也许他们希望自己拒绝了那个机会，因为实际上，远离你的支持系统和一切你熟悉的事物，生活并不总是像你预期的那样美好。

sentences.en: So really be realistic when you are thinking about which courses, which job offers you want to apply to.
sentences.zh: 所以，当你考虑申请哪些课程、哪些工作机会时，一定要现实一点。

sentences.en: And you might well have been in my world for a little while and you might well recall that I've already spoken about my experiences kind of burning out,
sentences.zh: 你可能在我的世界里待了一段时间，可能还记得我谈过自己职业倦怠的经历，

sentences.en: crying on the stairs because I was applying to job offers in Birmingham in the Lake District in Nottingham.
sentences.zh: 因为我当时在申请伯明翰、湖区和诺丁汉的工作机会，而我当时哭着坐在楼梯上。

sentences.en: And I was living in in between Northampton and Milton Keynes.
sentences.zh: 我当时住在北安普顿和米尔顿凯恩斯之间。

sentences.en: And it's just a lot, you know, you can't you can't do it all.
sentences.zh: 这真的太多了，你知道，你不可能面面俱到。

sentences.en: And so just being realistic with yourself, giving yourself, you know, the kindest journey that you can and the most compassionate is so important.
sentences.zh: 所以，对自己现实一点，给自己一段尽可能友善、尽可能充满同理心的旅程，这非常重要。

sentences.en: There is no guarantee in this field.
sentences.zh: 在这个领域没有绝对的保证。

sentences.en: But what we know is that by keeping our hand in and, you know, trying to learn, trying to grow, trying to develop,
sentences.zh: 但我们知道，通过保持参与，你知道，尝试学习、尝试成长、尝试发展，

sentences.en: trying to take on feedback from people that we trust and value and respect can improve your chances.
sentences.zh: 尝试接受我们信任、重视和尊重的人的反馈，可以提高你的成功机会。

sentences.en: You know, practice reflection, practice vulnerability in your supervision sessions.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在督导环节中练习反思，练习展现脆弱。

sentences.en: And that will hopefully pay rich dividends.
sentences.zh: 希望这会带来丰厚的回报。

sentences.en: And last but not least, we have point number eight.
sentences.zh: 最后但同样重要的一点，我们有第八点。

sentences.en: And it's celebrating those small wins.
sentences.zh: 那就是庆祝那些小小的胜利。

sentences.en: On my computer, I have a folder that I call the smile file.
sentences.zh: 在我的电脑上，我有一个文件夹，我称之为“微笑档案”。

sentences.en: And it's whenever I get something nice happen to me or said about me or things I think about myself,
sentences.zh: 每当我遇到什么好事，或者听到别人对我的好评，或者想到关于我自己的优点时，

sentences.en: I add it in there so that when I'm feeling like I've got a little bit of a low ebb,
sentences.zh: 我都会把它加进去，这样当我感到情绪低落时，

sentences.en: I can go along to that and reflect on things that have been enjoyable, maybe things I've got to look forward to as well.
sentences.zh: 我就可以去看看，反思一下那些令人愉快的经历，也许还有我所期待的事情。

sentences.en: My sister-in-law is a big advocate of using her fridge to display lists of things that she's got coming up that feel really exciting.
sentences.zh: 我的嫂子非常喜欢用冰箱来展示她即将到来的、让她感到非常兴奋的事情清单。

sentences.en: And that might well be something, you know, you can use as a mood board, use an aspiration.
sentences.zh: 这可能也是你可以使用的东西，把它当作情绪板，当作一种愿望。

sentences.en: If your aspiration is to be a qualified clinical psychologist or a trainee clinical psychologist or educational psychologist or forensic psychologist, for example,
sentences.zh: 如果你的愿望是成为一名合格的临床心理学家，或者受训临床心理学家、教育心理学家或法医心理学家，例如，

sentences.en: then you can set that.
sentences.zh: 那么你可以设定这个目标。

sentences.en: You can put that on your fridge as a, you know, not necessarily as a manifestation technique, but to remind yourself day after day where you're going,
sentences.zh: 你可以把它贴在冰箱上，你知道，不一定非要作为一种显化技巧，而是为了提醒自己日复一日地朝着目标前进，

sentences.en: where you're heading to and why.
sentences.zh: 明确你要去哪里，以及为什么要去。

sentences.en: So, yes, celebrating and kind of goal setting is point eight.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，庆祝和设定目标是第八点。

sentences.en: I hope you have found this useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这些内容很有用。

sentences.en: I would love any thoughts that you have got.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意听到你的任何想法。

sentences.en: Come along and connect with me on social media.
sentences.zh: 来社交媒体上和我建立联系吧。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我到处都是 Marianne Trent 博士。

sentences.en: If you're watching this on YouTube, let me know in the comments what you think to this episode.
sentences.zh: 如果你是在 YouTube 上观看，请在评论区告诉我你对这一集的看法。

sentences.en: Please do like, share, tell your friends, do subscribe, do all those good things.
sentences.zh: 请务必点赞、分享、告诉你的朋友，一定要订阅，做所有这些好事。

sentences.en: And please do check out my back catalogue of free Q&A sessions, the compassionate Q&A.
sentences.zh: 也请务必查看我往期的免费问答环节，即同理心问答。

sentences.en: So, I'm on your team.
sentences.zh: 所以，我是站在你这边的。

sentences.en: I would like to be able to support you more, but I need to know how to do that.
sentences.zh: 我希望能为你提供更多支持，但我需要知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: So, if there's something that you would like, do get in contact.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你有什么需求，请务必联系我。

sentences.en: Do let me know.
sentences.zh: 一定要告诉我。

sentences.en: Please, if you do find these episodes helpful, please do leave me an audio testimonial.
sentences.zh: 请务必，如果你觉得这些剧集有帮助，请给我留下音频感言。

sentences.en: If you've read the books, please do leave me a Goodreads or Amazon review.
sentences.zh: 如果你读过这些书，请务必在 Goodreads 或亚马逊上给我留下评论。

sentences.en: It is so welcomed.
sentences.zh: 这非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: Be kind to yourself.
sentences.zh: 善待自己。

sentences.en: Now, this is not an easy process, but I know it is worthwhile, at least for me, because every day I am still choosing to say yes to self-reaching.
sentences.zh: 现在，这并不是一个容易的过程，但我知道它是值得的，至少对我来说是这样，因为每一天我仍然选择对自我提升说“是”。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: Be kind to yourself, and I'll see you for the next episode, which will be landing at 10 a.m.
sentences.zh: 善待自己，我们下一集再见，下一集将于上午 10 点发布，

sentences.en: on Saturdays on YouTube and 6 a.m.
sentences.zh: 在周六的 YouTube 上，以及凌晨 6 点。

sentences.en: on Mondays for the MP3.
sentences.zh: 周一发布 MP3。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 各位心理学家，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，会怎样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要告诉大家。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022, and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我本人在2022年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的转型之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses, plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的推广链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师课、个性化指导、一份福特纳姆和梅森的礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10 p.m.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日周一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 请通过描述栏中的链接访问我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，随时可以找我。
